Creates a golden-ratio rectangle on a plane from an X interval.

**Panel:** Comma → Util · **Nickname:** `GoldRec`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plane | `P` | Plane | Item | `Plane.WorldXY` | Rectangle base plane |
| X Size | `X` | Interval | Item | `new Interval(-1000, 1000)` | Dimensions of rectangle in plane X direction. |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rectangle | `R` | Rectangle | Item | Golden rectangle |
